selected_frontier.reason: PR514 already composes typed semantic checkpoint identity with external admission into an immutable/CAS-selected lineage head, while PR240 already supplies a surviving external execution-generation floor. The remaining high-information gap is composition with external anchor identity/freshness without duplicating either mechanism.
duplicate_avoidance: PR514 was inspected and retained as the selected-lineage composition base rather than reimplemented.
PR240 was inspected and retained as the external generation-floor mechanism rather than reimplemented.
PR515 and current F-V01-13 evidence were used to preserve the rule that generic self-hosted/digital-retina observations do not prove accepted Hostinger identity.

selected_lineage_v3.remaining_explicit_limitation: external admission content can still be cloned or rolled back; trusted boot-time external-anchor/freshness verification remains required

external_generation_floor.mechanism: monotonic floor outside UnifiedDB snapshot plus anchor_instance and recovery generation ordering
external_generation_floor.explicit_limitation: does not protect whole-VM/filesystem rollback when the external anchor is rolled back too

generated_reality.hypothesis: A selected V3 lineage admission that binds both the surviving external floor epoch and a domain-separated digest of the full external anchor identity can reject equal-epoch sibling anchors while preserving explicit fail-closed target/artifact policy checks.
generated_reality.strongest_counterhypothesis: Epoch equality may be sufficient because a valid monotonic floor already identifies the current recovery generation; adding anchor-instance identity may add complexity without discriminating any meaningful sibling state.
generated_reality.hidden_assumption: The supplied external anchor snapshot is independently trusted and lies outside the rollback failure domain being claimed; this candidate cannot establish that trust itself.
generated_reality.falsifier: Construct two anchor states with equal floor epoch/revision but distinct anchor instances. If an epoch-only predicate and the full anchor digest both accept the sibling treatment, the proposed identity composition has no discriminatory value.

go_out_of_box.name: EQUAL_EPOCH_SIBLING_ANCHOR_SWAP
go_out_of_box.interpretation: Equal generation numbers alone do not identify the surviving external anchor. Binding the full anchor identity distinguishes this sibling treatment. This does not establish a production exploit and does not solve an exact clone/rollback of both lineage and external anchor.

external_evidence.finding: Trusted clients retain prior trusted metadata/version state specifically to detect rollback and mix-and-match classes; this supports preserving externally anchored freshness as a separate trust dimension rather than treating content identity as freshness.
Restore can require revision advancement/compaction so consumers do not accept stale views as current; this supports explicit post-restore generation semantics rather than silent rollback acceptance.

behavior: Domain-separate an external anchor digest over schema, positive floor_epoch, revision and anchor_instance.
Revalidate selected V3 head and external admission content hashes.
Require trusted-caller target-body identity and artifact identity to match admission exactly.
Require admission anchor_epoch to equal the surviving external floor.
Require admission external_anchor_digest to equal the full derived anchor identity.
Return authority NONE and never claim external anchor trust was verified by the module.
Preserve the explicit limitation that an exact clone of both lineage and external anchor remains indistinguishable without stronger out-of-snapshot freshness authority.

initial_run.failure_detail: wrapper asserted V3 status == PASS instead of the existing exact candidate status string; no semantic candidate failure

execution_evidence.repair: Only the CI wrapper assertion was corrected; no candidate semantics or safety invariant were weakened.

counterevidence_preserved: An exact clone of the selected lineage plus the exact external anchor remains content-identical and is intentionally not claimed safe by this candidate.
The module does not verify the trust, location, persistence or non-clonability of the external anchor.
The successful self-hosted run executed on digital-retina and is not accepted Hostinger production evidence.
The candidate is stacked on PR514 rather than recomposed on current product main and therefore is not current-main production integration evidence.
No clean start/restart/restore, stale sibling/transplant, whole-VM rollback or productive service integration has been proven by this candidate.

full external anchor identity digest plus selected V3 admission distinguishes equal-epoch sibling anchors
